Undergraduate and Graduate Programs

Our Academic Schools

We aim to be the best residential university in East Africa, by offering a wonderful learning experience for our students and faculty. We offer programs in undergraduate, diplomas and certificates levels at our main campus.

From undergraduate to doctoral levels, our schools—including the Center for Executive Education (CEE)—are designed to deliver academic excellence and industry relevance.

Library & E-Resources

Lukenya University Library identifies with the quality objectives of the university as spelt out in its quality policy. The library is committed to fostering the attainment of the university vision and mission. The library is committed to excellence in provision and use of information and knowledge for teaching, research, learning and community service. In order to deliver quality services that meet the information requirements of you (our users) we strive to uphold the core values of the university which focuses on quality, teamwork, accountability, and transparency.

Research & Innovation

Lukenya University boasts of a fully-fledged Directorate of Research, Innovation and Outreach in the Division of Academic and Research. The division is mandated to oversee and grow capacity and activities in R & O among faculty and students. The following are its key functions; Outreach Activities: The University supports outreach activities among faculty and students through an internal outreach fund as well as in conjunction with vaR & Ous external partners. Key engagements in this area include digital literacy outreach, public health awareness, career and life counseling, as well as the dissemination of research and innovation outputs. Linkages: Through memorandum of understanding, agreement and cooperation, the University engages industry, community, non-governmental organizations and government agencies for a variety of R & O activities such as conferences, exhibitions, outreach and research activities.

Scholarship Programs

Lukenya University offers a variety of scholarships, grants, and work-study opportunities to help students finance their education and achieve their academic goals.
